purpose: The decorative backdrop a site, hub or docs band stands on, for a `Hero` `background` slot or any band with `relative overflow-hidden`: `globe` hangs half a globe past the page's inline-end rule over the dot lattice, `map` insets the world map beside the copy, `network` lays the map full bleed with its PoPs lit and a scrim over the copy column. From the design sample's `shared/ui/banners` (GlobeBanner, MapBanner, NetworkBanner), drawn with WebKit's own `SpinningGlobe` and `NetworkMap` so there is one map and one globe in the system. The inventory's "`Banner` `art` variants" became this sibling component under `marketing/banner`: `Banner` is an announcement band with its own surfaces, and a backdrop layer is a different thing.
useWhen: Behind the opening band of a landing, the hub or the docs home.
avoidWhen: As content: it is `aria-hidden` and says nothing.
Behind dense text or a form.
bestPractices: Keep the copy at the inline start: every art is washed toward it.
